"""Exact scalar book publication, unchanged capacity and native rendered guidance."""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, need, pin, save

CHAPTER = Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
REGISTRY = Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
ANCHOR = 'The complete finite raw-address and numerical/source parent acceptance is now\nqualified.'
ADDITION = '''Non-predicate scalar operands now have their own complete source qualification.
The source producer and a separate direct traversal preserve every supplied or
default value, ordered role and operand schema. Entire inherited inner error
strings remain dated evidence; exercising those strings does not establish an
independent semantic source for their original native contents.

The current public fixtures construct each complete selected string from its
codepoints, each selected integer numerically, and each undefined value as
undef. Explicit argument-length profiles of 64 and 0 qualify bounded displays
and complete displays respectively. The separate checker compares complete
values, headers and trace bodies. A displayed prefix never replaces the full
source value, and original native scalar flags and formatter settings remain
unmeasured. Whole membership, role, schema, constructor, tail, profile and
scope controls reject their intended defects.

Replay the complete dated scalar qualification:

```sh
scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/observer-scalar-values-20261010/verify.py
```

Regex construction, original receiver and referent identity, private framework
intervals, source do versus diagnostic require roles, complete original headers
and unchanged parent acceptance retain their separate owners. This scalar child
does not close the original observer or raw-stack contracts.

'''


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*args],capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,'whole fixed book authority')
    return result.stdout


def aggregate(rows):
    return dict(files=len(rows),lines_total=sum(r.count(b'\n') for r in rows),bytes_total=sum(map(len,rows)))


def source():
    names = sorted(name for name in git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
                   if Path(name).parent == Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md'))
    before = {name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names}
    need(before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().count(ANCHOR)==1 and ADDITION not in before[str(CHAPTER)].decode(), 'unique scalar guide source seam')
    after=dict(before)
    after[str(CHAPTER)]=before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().replace(ANCHOR,ADDITION+ANCHOR,1).encode()
    return before,after


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--publish',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    before,after=source()
    current={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}
    if args.publish:
        need(current==before, 'publish only the owned sole scalar book addition')
        CHAPTER.write_bytes(after[str(CHAPTER)])
        rows=[json.loads(line) for line in REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()]
        authority=next(r for r in rows if r.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')['reference_contract']
        a,b=aggregate(list(before.values())),aggregate(list(after.values()))
        authority['aggregate_change']=dict(authority_id='OBSERVER-SCALAR-VALUES-20261010',
            owner=(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0],baseline=a,
            delta={key:b[key]-a[key] for key in a},
            rationale='Document complete non-predicate scalar source values and finite current public constructors while retaining inherited evidence and all original opaque and successor boundaries.')
        REGISTRY.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for r in rows))
        save('book-publication.json',dict(revision=REVISION,addition=ADDITION,
            before={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()}, after={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},
            authority=authority['aggregate_change']))
        print('PASS exact sole scalar book addition and fresh aggregate authority; capacity ceilings unchanged.')
    else:
        need(current==after, 'entire current scalar book publication and complete unchanged peers')
        if args.native:
            class Text(HTMLParser):
                def __init__(self):
                    super().__init__();self.parts=[]
                def handle_data(self,data):
                    self.parts.append(data)
            raw=Path('docs/book/book/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.html').read_bytes()
            reader=Text();reader.feed(raw.decode())
            expected=' '.join(line for line in ADDITION.splitlines() if not line.startswith('```'))
            need(' '.join(''.join(reader.parts).split()).count(' '.join(expected.split()))==1,
                 'whole unique rendered scalar guide')
            save('book-native.json',dict(chapter=pin(raw),addition=pin(ADDITION.encode()),
                scope='Whole native guidance text and source custody only; visual book QA remains open.'))
        print('PASS complete current scalar guide and source publication; visual QA remains separately owned.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Capture only the preselected source-neutral public scalar constructors."""
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, SCOPE, load, need, pin, save


def main():
    pre = load('pre-observation.json')
    need(pre['native_present'] is False and pre['scope'] == SCOPE, 'source selection predates native observation')
    for name, identity in pre['inputs'].items():
        need(pin(Path(name).read_bytes()) == identity,
             'whole selected pre-observation source epoch')
    command = ['perl', '-Iperl', str(BASE / 'native.pl')]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    save('native.json', dict(command=command, status=result.returncode,
         stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr,
         inputs={str(BASE / name):pin((BASE / name).read_bytes()) for name in ('native.pl','plan.json')}))
    need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr, 'actual complete public native scalar capture')
    print('PASS preselected complete public scalar constructor capture; original execution is not recaptured.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
    need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Execute the complete committed prerequisite reader set without original recapture."""
import subprocess
from common import BASE, CENSUS, PREDICATE, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, module, need, pin, save
from run import execute


def main():
    prior = module(PREDICATE / 'common.py')
    readers = dict(prior['READERS'])
    readers['predicate-values'] = [str(PREDICATE / 'verify.py')]
    fixed = {}
    for path in [CENSUS / 'census.json', CENSUS / 'source-models.json',
                 PREDICATE / 'manifest-final.json', PREDICATE / 'predicate-values-qualified.json']:
        command = ['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True)
        need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr and result.stdout == path.read_bytes(),
             'whole fixed/current scalar prerequisite input')
        fixed[str(path)] = dict(identity=pin(result.stdout), command=command, status=result.returncode)
    receipts = {}
    for name, arguments in readers.items():
        receipts[name] = execute('prerequisite-' + name, ['python3', '-B', *arguments])
    save('prerequisites.json', dict(revision=REVISION, fixed=fixed,
         readers={k:pin(canonical(v)) for k,v in receipts.items()}, scope=SCOPE))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])

"""Replay complete scalar products, independent controls and immutable evidence."""
import copy
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, CENSUS, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, load, need, pin, read, same, save
import derive
import oracle
import scope_verify


def validation(product, selected, native):
    source = read(CENSUS / 'source-models.json')
    result = oracle.verify_source(source, product, selected)
    receipt = native
    need(receipt['command'] == ['perl', '-Iperl', str(BASE / 'native.pl')], 'exact selected native command')
    need(receipt['inputs'] == {str(BASE / n):pin((BASE / n).read_bytes()) for n in ('native.pl','plan.json')},
         'entire native driver and corpus identity')
    result['native'] = oracle.verify_native(selected, receipt, (BASE / 'native.pl').read_bytes())
    return result


def falsify(product, selected, native):
    import json
    controls = []
    def trial(name, mutate, cause):
        p, s, n = copy.deepcopy((product, selected, native))
        mutate(p, s, n)
        need(not same([p,s,n], [product,selected,native]), 'genuine whole hostile candidate')
        try:
            validation(p, s, n)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error) == cause, 'intended independent scalar control cause: ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
            controls.append(dict(name=name, cause=cause, candidate=dict(product=p, selected=s, native=n), status='rejected'))
        else:
            raise ValueError('accepted hostile scalar candidate: ' + name)

    members = 'complete independent scalar member/order/role/value allocation'
    trial('omitted-member', lambda p,s,n:p['members'].pop(), members)
    trial('reordered-member', lambda p,s,n:p['members'].reverse(), members)
    trial('borrowed-value-allocation', lambda p,s,n:p['members'][0].update(value=p['members'][1]['value']), members)
    trial('wrong-role', lambda p,s,n:p['members'][0]['operand'].update(role='borrowed'), members)
    trial('wrong-schema', lambda p,s,n:p['members'][0].update(schema='context_scalar'), members)
    trial('inherited-evidence-promotion', lambda p,s,n:next(r for r in p['members'] if r['evidence_role']=='inherited serialized evidence').update(evidence_role='qualified own-source value'), members)
    key = next(k for k,v in product['values'].items() if type(v['value']) is str and len(v['value']) > 64)
    trial('lost-complete-value-tail', lambda p,s,n:p['values'][key].update(value=p['values'][key]['value'][:61]), 'entire independently typed scalar value dictionary')
    trial('wrong-constructor', lambda p,s,n:p['values'][key].update(constructor='numeric literal'), 'entire independently typed scalar value dictionary')
    trial('original-flag-promotion', lambda p,s,n:p.update(scope=SCOPE+' Original flags measured.'), 'source versus inherited/native scope')
    trial('wrong-profile-hypothesis', lambda p,s,n:s['profile'].update(MaxArgNums=8), 'explicit selected public profile')
    trial('wrong-complete-token', lambda p,s,n:s['cases'][0]['display'].update(token='borrowed'), 'independent complete constructor and display hypotheses')
    def native_change(n, action):
        data=json.loads(n['stdout']);action(data);n['stdout']=canonical(data).decode()
    trial('boolean-status', lambda p,s,n:n.update(status=False), 'actual typed public capture success')
    trial('omitted-native-case', lambda p,s,n:native_change(n,lambda d:d['rows'].pop()), 'complete ordered public scalar corpus')
    trial('native-profile-borrowing', lambda p,s,n:native_change(n,lambda d:d['rows'][0]['profile'].update(MaxArgLen=1)), 'actual explicit current profile')
    trial('native-source-value-change', lambda p,s,n:native_change(n,lambda d:d['rows'][0]['value']['codepoints'].append(88)), 'complete native constructed scalar value')
    trial('native-whole-tail-change', lambda p,s,n:native_change(n,lambda d:d['rows'][0].update(trace=d['rows'][0]['trace']+'borrowed\n')), 'whole source-generated public scalar header and trace')
    # Keep whole candidates compact without dropping a byte or using their
    # count as evidence of correct allocation. Replay expands and reruns each.
    import gzip, base64
    return [dict(name=r['name'], cause=r['cause'], status=r['status'],
                 candidate_gzip_base64=base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(canonical(r['candidate']), mtime=0)).decode()) for r in controls]


def main():
    need(same(scope_verify.derive(),load('task-contracts.json')), 'complete unchanged source scalar acceptance')
    product, selected, native = load('scalars.json'), load('plan.json'), load('native.json')
    prerequisites = load('prerequisites.json')
    need(prerequisites['revision'] == REVISION and prerequisites['scope'] == SCOPE, 'whole fixed prerequisite scope')
    fixed_paths = {str(CENSUS/'census.json'), str(CENSUS/'source-models.json'),
        'docs/audits/observer-predicate-values-20261010/manifest-final.json',
        'docs/audits/observer-predicate-values-20261010/predicate-values-qualified.json'}
    need(set(prerequisites['fixed']) == fixed_paths, 'complete fixed scalar input domain')
    for name, item in prerequisites['fixed'].items():
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+name]
        actual=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(actual.returncode==0 and not actual.stderr and actual.stdout==Path(name).read_bytes()
             and item['command']==command and pin(actual.stdout) == item['identity']
             and type(item['status']) is int and item['status']==0,
             'whole fixed/current scalar input freshness')
    receipts = {}
    for path in sorted(BASE.glob('actual-prerequisite-*.json')):
        record=read(path)
        need(type(record['status']) is int and record['status']==0 and record['stderr']==''
             and record['stdout'].endswith('\n') and 'PASS ' in record['stdout'], 'complete actual prerequisite result')
        name=path.stem[len('actual-prerequisite-'):-2]
        need(name not in receipts, 'unique prerequisite execution')
        receipts[name]=pin(canonical(record))
    need(same(receipts,prerequisites['readers']), 'whole actual prerequisite population and result pins')
    from common import PREDICATE, module
    expected_readers=dict(module(PREDICATE/'common.py')['READERS'])
    expected_readers['predicate-values']=[str(PREDICATE/'verify.py')]
    need(set(receipts)==set(expected_readers), 'complete declared prerequisite reader domain')
    for name,arguments in expected_readers.items():
        need(load('actual-prerequisite-'+name+'-1.json')['command']==['python3','-B',*arguments],
             'exact complete prerequisite command')
    need(same(derive.collect(read(CENSUS/'census.json')),product)
         and same(derive.plan(product),selected), 'complete source product and preselected corpus rederive')
    result=validation(product,selected,native)
    controls=falsify(product,selected,native)
    if (BASE/'controls.json').exists():
        need(same(controls,load('controls.json')), 'whole independently replayed negative controls')
    else:
        save('controls.json',controls)
    for path in BASE.glob('actual-*.json'):
        record=read(path)
        need(type(record['status']) is int and type(record['stdout']) is str and type(record['stderr']) is str,
             'whole typed actual result, including failures')
        for body in record['programs'].values():
            need(pin(body['body'].encode())==body['identity'],'complete actual program epoch')
    if (BASE/'manifest.json').exists():
        need(load('manifest.json')=={str(p.relative_to(BASE)):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in BASE.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name not in ('manifest.json','checks.json')}, 'whole immutable scalar qualification namespace')
    proof=dict(result=result, controls=pin(canonical(controls)), scope=SCOPE)
    if (BASE/'proof.json').exists():
        need(same(proof,load('proof.json')), 'whole immutable scalar qualification proof')
    else:
        save('proof.json',proof)
    print('PASS complete source scalars, independently reconstructed members/values/constructors, whole current public headers and genuine controls; inherited evidence and original opaque scopes retain.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
